identificationModule.briefTitle: Ibrutinib With Rituximab in Adults With Waldenström's Macroglobulinemia
identificationModule.officialTitle: iNNOVATE Study: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo- Controlled, Phase 3 Study of Ibrutinib or Placebo in Combination With Rituximab in Subjects With Waldenström's Macroglobulinemia

armGroups.label: Randomized Study (Ibrutinib + Rituximab)
armGroups.description: Ibrutinib: 420 mg (3 capsules x 140 mg) orally administered daily beginning from Day 1. Rituximab: 375 mg/m\^2 intravenous (IV) per package insert weekly for four consecutive weeks, followed by a second four-weekly rituximab course after a three-month interval.

armGroups.label: Randomized Study (Placebo + Rituximab)
armGroups.description: Placebo: 3 capsules of placebo orally administered daily beginning from Day 1. Rituximab: 375 mg/m\^2 IV per package insert weekly for four consecutive weeks, followed by a second four-weekly rituximab course after a three-month interval.

armGroups.label: Open-Label Substudy (Ibrutinib)
armGroups.description: Ibrutinib: 420 mg (3 capsules) orally administered daily beginning from Day 1.

interventions.name: Ibrutinib
interventions.description: Participants will receive 420 mg of Ibrutinib orally.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Participants will receive placebo capsules orally.

interventions.name: Rituximab
interventions.description: Participants will receive rituximab 375 mg/m\^2 IV.
